# CI decision log

Read by every CI agent before proposing anything (see `README.md` in this
folder). Two parts: standing principles the owner has set, and a log of
decided ideas. Agents never edit the principles. The critic appends to the
log through its rolling draft PR (`claude/ci-decision-log`).

## Standing principles

- The app is used mid-workout, one-handed, on a phone: fewer taps and
  readable-at-a-glance beat feature density.
- Nothing reaches `main` without the owner merging it.
- Ideas must be backed by evidence or carry a measurement plan
  (`hypothesis`).
- Licensed program content is not changed by CI agents.
- The repository is public: no personal or athlete data on GitHub, ever.
